label: OINP 不符合清单
note: 人工维护的政策事实表(非抓取;2026-07-25 Frank 拍板)。OINP 2026-06-25 改制生效后唯一的 Workforce Priority 流按 TEER 0-3 / TEER 4-5 两路径覆盖全部职业(全职+永久 offer),官方不设职业清单 → 排除集为空 = TEER 0-5 全部可走省提名。官网 7-20 细则页复核。若 ON 重新引入职业清单,删本文件并按 git 史 build_on.py 模板重写抓取。2026-09-26 复核(crawl on-oinp 当日缓存):流页 https://www.ontario.ca/page/ontario-workforce-priority-stream(Updated: August 11, 2026)原句「work experience in any National Occupational Classification (NOC) occupation」;2026 更新页 8-4 条(EOI 门户开放)原句「pathways for individuals with job offers in all National Occupational Classification (NOC) Training, Education, Experience and Responsibilities (TEER) categories」;官方仍无职业清单,排除集仍为空。2026-09-27 改判(lead 派工「安省旧通道停发日 06-25 / 06-26 两个说法」):改制日由 06-26 改为 06-25 —— 官方 2026 更新页 https://www.ontario.ca/page/2026-ontario-immigrant-nominee-program-updates 的 June 26, 2026 条原句「These amendments came into force on June 25, 2026.」「No further invitations will be issued under the former program streams.」;06-26 是公告日(同页 7-20 条原句「announced on June 26, 2026」)。旧流各自的归档页另有一句「this stream was closed as of May 30, 2026」(on-req.json 照录),本表取法规生效日。
